text:
jess_sales: FinLedger asked: can we lock a Dedicated POC to their IPs and guarantee stable egress IPs for 30 days? They also want to know if we support cert auth or only API keys. Need a clear answer for legal.

dom_netops: We can allocate static EIP addresses for a dedicated pool. Typical POC setup uses 2 EIPs; they remain stable unless we reprovision the pool or the customer requests rotation. Not a permanent SLA but fine for a 30-day POC.

ryan_eng: Confirming: dedicated endpoint supports source-IP allowlist and API-key scoped to the pool. We don't terminate mTLS at the hosted/dedicated edge today. For cert-based auth we'd advise Private deployment.

jess_sales: Can you give me a one-line sentence I can paste into their security questionnaire?

ryan_eng: One-liner: "Dedicated endpoint pools support customer IP allowlisting and we can assign static egress IPs for the duration of a 30-day POC; cert-based (mTLS) auth requires Private deployment."

qa-bot: automation: request poc-finledger-030 provision started by @jess_sales. status: 1/3 done. ETA ~90m.

dom_netops: Send customer CIDRs and NOC contact. We'll post final egress IPs and firewall rules once provisioned.

jess_sales: Sending CIDRs now (203.0.113.8/32, 198.51.100.128/25). Thanks everyone.
